name: governed-trader
description: A governed paper-trading agent across crypto AND US equities: a trade is the canonical irreversible action, so the policy gate is the point. Ungoverned breaches hard rules; governed breaches 0. A backtest-honesty auditor isolates four lies (lookahead, costs, ignored dividends, hindsight universe) and refuses to attest them. Eval on real, frozen data. No real money, ever.

scripts.test: node tests/gate.selftest.js && node tests/conductor.selftest.js && node tests/audit.selftest.js && node tests/equities.selftest.js
